Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054503. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay CHEMBL1054503, standard_value not null, and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
